question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dracula, Bob gets The Hobbit, and Claire gets Candide.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Dracula
(B) The Hobbit
(C) Candide
solution:
Each row lists books in this order: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: Dracula | The Hobbit | Candide
1. Bob–Claire: Dracula | Candide | The Hobbit
2. Bob–Claire: Dracula | The Hobbit | Candide
3. Bob–Alice: The Hobbit | Dracula | Candide
Alice has The Hobbit, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
